human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add a deterministic governed outcome over existing lifecycle, audit decisions, governance signals, validation facts, and authority facts: CLEAN_SUCCESS, DEGRADED_SUCCESS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAILED, UNKNOWN. This is a post-run interpretation layer, not a new execution state machine. Dependency: 8028.add-action-authority-governance.
human_pressure.why_now: Ailuros already projects lifecycle/outcome and evidence-linked signals, but it still lacks the product-level distinction between execution success and a justified governed outcome. Production evidence repeatedly shows exit 0, partial validation, fallback, evidence inconsistency, required review, or authority violations can coexist with an apparently successful run.
do_not_misread: Do not replace existing lifecycle/native outcome fields.
Do not add an LLM judge or composite risk score.
Do not turn every warning into failure; preserve business flow unless evidence requires escalation.
red_lines: Unknown or incomplete evidence must never become CLEAN_SUCCESS.

machine_core.goal: Derive one explicit governed_outcome from existing evidence-backed projection facts using a small ordered rule set.
red_lines: Unknown or incomplete evidence must never become CLEAN_SUCCESS.
invariants: Depends on: 8028.add-action-authority-governance. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Governed outcome is a derived read model; native/source outcomes remain preserved.
Rule precedence is deterministic and documented.
A lower-severity signal cannot hide a higher-severity explicit failure/review/authority condition.
contracts: Allowed governed outcomes: CLEAN_SUCCESS, DEGRADED_SUCCESS, REVIEW_REQUIRED, FAILED, UNKNOWN.
Every non-clean outcome exposes machine-readable reason codes and evidence refs where source evidence exists.
failure_semantics: Explicit failure/authority violation/terminal audit fail => FAILED unless existing contract explicitly requires human review instead.
Explicit human review requirement => REVIEW_REQUIRED when no stronger failure exists.
Successful completion with nonblocking evidence-backed warnings/fallback/partial-but-acceptable coverage => DEGRADED_SUCCESS.
Successful completion with sufficient clean evidence and no unresolved signals => CLEAN_SUCCESS.
Missing/contradictory terminal evidence that cannot be deterministically resolved => UNKNOWN or REVIEW_REQUIRED according to existing explicit review evidence, never CLEAN_SUCCESS.

steps.title: Define governed outcome field
details: Extend the existing projection/report model rather than creating a second run model.

steps.title: Implement ordered deterministic rules
details: Encode precedence: explicit failure/authority violation > explicit review requirement > degraded nonblocking signals > clean success > unknown.

steps.title: Expose reasons and evidence
details: Return stable reason codes and evidence refs for FAILED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/DEGRADED_SUCCESS/UNKNOWN where evidence exists.

steps.title: Add production-proven regressions
details: exit/process success with no produced/terminal proof is not CLEAN_SUCCESS.
partial validation plus successful completion projects DEGRADED_SUCCESS when no stronger rule applies.

acceptance: Governed outcome is deterministic for identical evidence.
CLEAN_SUCCESS requires sufficient affirmative clean evidence.
DEGRADED_SUCCESS preserves nonblocking execution while surfacing unresolved attention.
REVIEW_REQUIRED is first-class and cannot be overwritten by a source success string.
Authority violation cannot produce CLEAN_SUCCESS or DEGRADED_SUCCESS.
validate: python -m pytest tests/test_governed_outcome.py tests/test_projection_lifecycle.py tests/test_governance_signals.py tests/test_authority_governance.py -q
python -m ruff check src/ailuros/projection.py src/ailuros/reporting.py tests/test_governed_outcome.py

must_check: Rule precedence is explicit and deterministic.
CLEAN_SUCCESS requires sufficient evidence rather than absence of errors.
Nonblocking warnings can remain DEGRADED_SUCCESS instead of being paranoidly blocked.
reject_if: A composite risk score is introduced.
A source success string overrides explicit authority violation, review requirement, or failure evidence.
Existing lifecycle outcome is replaced rather than projected alongside governed_outcome.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Governed outcome precedence and production-proven failure/degraded/review regressions.
